School of Physics, Chemistry and Earth Sciences
Our study areas
School of Physics, Chemistry and Earth Sciences
Show menu
World-class teaching, real-world science
Our degrees span physics, chemistry, geology, environmental science, geophysics, nuclear science and space exploration.
You’ll learn from leading scientists and gain deep knowledge and practical skills through state-of-the-art labs, fieldwork, exploring historic collections and real-world projects.
We offer overseas study, study tours and internships that build confidence, enhance employability and expand career prospects.
Study areas
Physics
Explore the most basic and fundamental science, crucial to our understanding of the world around us. Our undergraduate courses in physics are accredited by the Australian Institute of Physics .
